title: Matching Complexity for Second-Order Stationary Point with Sample Reuse
summary: We consider stochastic nonconvex optimization with sample-wise Lipschitz gradients and Hessians, and reusable opaque sample handles. Gradient and complete-Hessian evaluations are charged separately, including both endpoints of a same-sample difference.
